target.name: Corrego do Feijao Dam I, Brumadinho
target.note: adjacent descending track; first post-collapse pass 29 Jan 2019

source.attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2019, processed by ASF HyP3

method: Interferometric coherence over the dam footprint vs a stable control area, for a pre-collapse pair (5-17 Jan) and the pair spanning the failure (17-29 Jan). Coherence measures whether the ground surface physically persisted between passes. A blind search for the strongest coherence loss anywhere in the 14 km scene lands on the dam site itself.
